items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Because I know that Benny Goodman stole – stole? – borrowed his arranger.

ctx.x: He was around, but I don’t really remember his band too well. I think he was a little bit before my time.
Because I know that Benny Goodman stole – stole? – borrowed his arranger.
Well, he’s arranging for him. He and Don.
